additional_concerns: The representation accepts exposure and designation as supplied judgments; it does not implement asset identification, exposure measurement or the SFC's holistic assessment. Omitted upstream detail is not by itself a defect in this route-satisfaction question.

The indirect-exposure examples are expressly non-exhaustive under d4148dd852cee.u59.7979. Any upstream implementation that limits eligible channels to the named instruments would add an unsupported restriction.
An operative designation is evidence of an SFC decision, not permission for the management company to substitute its own assessment of designation factors.

The source supplies no persistence or declassification rule. The assessment-time convention must not be used to infer that historical complex-product status automatically ceases when exposure falls below 50%.
The supplied missing dependency IDs have no identifying metadata. No reliable mapping to particular external authorities can be made.
Global conflict blocking is an explicit evidentiary runtime convention, not a rule stated in the circular; it can prevent a result even when an independent classification route is established.
